testcase.name: encode then decode round-trips name, fields and aar package()
profile without aar package round-trips as null, not a literal string()
valid json missing required fields is rejected as corrupt()
invalid base64 ndef payload is rejected as corrupt rather than crashing()
unknown payload type discriminator is rejected as corrupt()
unknown extra json fields are tolerated for forward compatibility()
future format version is rejected with an unsupported-version error()
garbage input is rejected as corrupt, not an uncaught exception()
blank profile name is rejected as corrupt()
